end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0190 (a b q r : Nat) (h1 : b > 0) (h2 : a = b * q + r) (h3 : 0 ≤ r) (h4 : r < b) : q ≤ a / b := by
  have h5 : a - b * q = r := by rw [h2]
  have h6 : a - b * q < b := by linarith [h4]
  have h7 : a < b * (q + 1) := by
    rw [h5]

  have h8 : a / b ≤ q + 1 := by

    rw [Nat.div_add_mod]
  have h10 : a / b ≤ q + 1 := by
    linarith [h8]
  have h11 : a / b ≤ q := by
    linarith [h10]
  exact h11
end Nl2LeanCandidate
